The '''1971–72 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 36th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 19 September 1971 and ended on 25 June 1972. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their 11th Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
